title: Warm Smoked Russian Potatoes Gratin
description: Fermented, velvety, adventurous Russian dish featuring yukon gold potatoes, smoke-cold, keto-friendly.
instructions: Thinly slice the yukon gold potatoes and place in a single layer on a plate.
Microwave the sliced potatoes for 30 seconds to soften slightly.
Arrange the potatoes in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together heavy cream, smoked cheese, salt, and pepper.
Pour the cream mixture over the potatoes in the baking dish.
Sprinkle the chopped scallions, crumbled smoked bacon, chopped parsley, and chopped pickled onions evenly over the potatoes.
Dot the top of the potatoes with the softened butter.
Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped dill and chopped chives.
Serve warm, garnished with additional chopped herbs if desired.
